In Beacon, add a Custom platform. Select %1$s as Player app and the exported butterpollo folder as ROMs folder. Include .art in the file extensions. Under Advanced, use Default file handling, enable Use custom launch and paste the command below. Save and scan the platform.
Restart ES-DE to load the Nightjar system. If you skipped its configuration folder, select it on your next export to add the system and cached covers.
Create a platform for .art files in the exported butterpollo folder. Add an Android player with the intent arguments below, then scan the folder.
Use the exported butterpollo folder and .art entries. Set the launch command below in your collection metadata.
